transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, thank you. I suppose... well, it's mostly because my wife thinks I'm not eating enough. That's why I'm here. But really, most days I just have my coffee and a piece of toast in the morning, and then maybe a little soup or some vegetables later in the day. Big meals just feel completely unnecessary at my age. I don't really see the problem, but she wanted me to come talk to you.
How have your mood and spirits been lately?

My mood? Oh, it's fine. I haven't really noticed any problems there. I'm not feeling sad or down, if that's what you're asking. Just... going about my normal routine, really. I'd say my spirits are as good as they've always been.
Have you noticed any problems with your memory or day-to-day thinking lately?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean, at my age, you might forget a name here or there, but my memory is still sharp. I keep track of everything just fine around the house, pay my bills on time... all of that. My thinking hasn't changed at all.
What is the main reason you find yourself eating so little these days?

Well, I just... I don't want to gain weight. When my wife tries to put butter on things, or if she sets down a big, full plate in front of me, I get nervous. I worry that I'll start putting weight back on and just lose the control I've worked so hard to keep.
Could you tell me what your current height and weight are?

I'm about 5 foot 9. As for my weight... well, my regular doctor tells me the number on the scale has gotten too low lately. I don't really see it that way, though. To me, being lighter just makes it easier to get around the garden and keep up on my walks.
Could you tell me what the specific number on the scale is when you weigh yourself?

Well, I don't really know the exact number right now. I don't weigh myself at home. I just know my doctor said it was lower than he'd like, but I didn't pay too much attention to the specific number he mentioned.
Have you noticed any decrease in your sexual interest or problems with sexual potency recently?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean... at my age, it's not exactly the main focus of my days anyway, but there hasn't been any sudden drop or new problems recently. Everything seems about the same as it has been.
Roughly how much weight have you lost since you started cutting down on your food?

I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. Since I don't have a scale at the house... well, I just haven't been keeping track of it like that. I know my trousers are fitting a bit looser than they used to, but as for the actual number of pounds I've dropped, I really couldn't tell you.
When you look at yourself in the mirror, do you feel that any part of your body is too fat?

Well, mostly it's my stomach. If I look in the mirror and see it looking even the least bit rounded, I just feel... sloppy, I suppose. And disappointed in myself. But on the other hand, if my belt feels a notch looser, then I feel like I've done right by myself. So, yes, I do pay attention to that.
Do you push yourself to walk or exercise excessively in order to control your weight?

No, I don't do anything like that. I'm 78, so excessive exercise isn't really in the cards for me anyway. I just try to eat less to keep the weight off, but I don't push myself to walk miles or work out or anything of that sort.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating to keep from gaining weight?
No, I don't do that. I've never made myself sick or thrown up after a meal. I just stick to eating smaller amounts.
Do you take any laxatives, diet pills, or water pills to help keep your weight down?
No, I don't take any of those. No laxatives, no diet pills... nothing like that. I just manage it by, well, by eating less, like I mentioned. I don't mess with any pills for my weight.

Absence of reported endocrine disturbance (preserved sexual interest and potency)
